scope: Imported drug appendices and selected legal chunks, with a verified Article 8 TT20/2022 supplement; not all Vietnamese health-insurance legislation.
latest_search_result: No promulgated replacement of TT20 drug list found in searches as of this date; official Sep/Oct 2026 reports still describe revision. This is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.

exclusion_rules.note: Original wording amended by TT37 Article 20(3); use consolidated source and CV3293.
Do not apply in reimbursement until condition under Article 20(2) is met; not a wholesale immediate replacement of TT20 hospital columns.

supporting_rules.note: Read together with TT18_2025 and TT06_2026. Default off to avoid partial-version errors.
